title: Recipes Every Home Cook Should Know Ep 18 | Japanese Curry Beef Bowls #cooking #recipe
description:
The recipes every home cook should know. Ep 18: Japanese Curry Beef Bowls

Comment if you don't know where to find the full written recipe, but here's what you need to make it: 

- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 tbsp oil
- 1 tsp salt (to taste)
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 yellow onion,
- 1 large carrot
- 6 cloves garlic
- 1 inch frozen ginger
- 2-3 blocks spicy Japanese curry
- 1 to 1.5 cups milk
- ½ cup frozen peas
- 1–2 tbsp tonkatsu sauce, ketchup, or ½ apple
